ass:operational-package.title: Operational reconstruction package
ass:operational-package.note: Clauses (O1)-(O5) are encoded across the operational framework of the renewal_emergence track: causal finite convex reduced datum (OpTheory + complete contextual equivalence records), pure dilation/sharp seed (SharpPurificationPkg, DetMarking), the transitive one-dimensional phase action (Jordan face records), and qubit-power monoidal closure (IsCompletelyAncillaryStable). Clause (O6) on holistic fibres is carried by the parallel-completion and rebit-counterexample records (ParallelComplete, cctxEquiv_maximal, prop:rebit-parallel-counterexample). Assumption package: statement-level by design.

prop:common-object.title: Common finite object
prop:common-object.note: Assembly of the renewal_emergence chain thm:structural-reconstruction / thm:complex-algebra / thm:operational-ucp / lem:choi, all proved. Step 1 (congruence quotient) is prop:largest-congruence + thm:universal-quotient; Step 3 (complex type from the phase orbit) is two_path_complex_face + coherence_dim_two_selects_complex; Step 4 (CP via qubit-power ampliation and Choi) is operationalToUCP + choi_criterion. Scope: Step 2, the finite sharp-purification-to-Euclidean-Jordan reconstruction, is the manuscript's declared established input and is statement-encoded only (thm:operational-jordan record); the finite Jordan classification list is likewise consumed as an input, not reproved. The direct resolved-instrument entry is the encoded tuple of the renewal ledger defs (branch maps, depths, capacities, pointer records).

ass:finite-phase.title: Finite Store--Read Lorentzian phase (P1)-(P9)
ass:finite-phase.note: P1-P2: hypotheses of pressure_selects_beta (positive weights, depth bounds, diagonal witness) plus IsPrimitive. P3-P5: Store coefficient algebra, stable pointer algebra and centre, KMS reverse (antiDual), interaction-complete monitoring (stable-pointer-selection records). P6: determinant-regular record transport and transposition holonomy (recSign, walkTransport, record-parity records). P7: RealizedReversibleData + RevisionFamily with the marked temporal complement. P8: SpatiallyNondegenerate + positive second moment. P9: common-source diamond kernel (diamondKernel, kernelPow). Nonemptiness of the whole package is PROVED on the explicit heat-bath/Ising model (cor:full-phase-nonempty, thm:common-origin-phase in the renewal ledger).

ass:scaling-package.title: Continuum scaling package (A1)-(A6)
ass:scaling-package.note: A1-A3 and A6 appear as hypotheses of the encoded continuum data (ResetField smoothness/nondegeneracy, KreinCliffordDatum, reset differences, bounded potential in the residue records). A4 (single Hilbert space, common cores, coercive forms) and the subprincipal consistency/compactness clauses of A5 are the library's known unformalized operator-analytic layer; the algebraic content of A5 (plaquette translational/rotational splitting) is proved (translational_defect, rotational_defect, rot_expand).

ass:selections.title: Selections and calibration (S1)-(S4)
ass:selections.note: S1: recurrent-component selection via the condensation order (prop:terminal-component, proved). S2: orientation-state selection; the necessity of a selection is proved (no_finite_spontaneous_orientation) and the admissible routes are catalogued (orientation_selection_routes). S3: zero-source exchange phase (sourcePressure_eq_zero_iff, torsion-phase coexistence proved). S4: unit calibration (calibratedRescale, dimensionless invariance records).

thm:predictive-geometry.title: Predictive reconstruction and positive geometry
thm:predictive-geometry.note: All six items are proved in the existing tracks. (i) thm:minimal-predictive-memory; (ii) lem:conditional-successor + thm:predictive-reference-renewal + cor:predictive-reference-path-law; (iii) cor:units-automorphisms via Kadison-Schwarz; (iv) thm:triple + thm:fibre-dichotomy with the zeta abscissa records; (v) lem:poset + prop:causal-skeleton; (vi) thm:irreducible-positive-no-go + thm:functorial-positive-obstruction (compatible involutions are edgewise Z/2 cochains).

thm:signed-clock.title: Minimal signed cover and modular clock
thm:signed-clock.note: (i)-(iii) proved: determinant orientation class and nontriviality from the record transposition (noisy-record-orientation and determinant-cover records), minimal rank-two cone-positive enrichment classified by H^1(G;Z/2) (classification records), Z/4 amplitude lifts with conservativity over the real layer. (iv)-(v) proved as the supercritical clause of pressure_selects_beta: unique positive root under 1 < r(0), for arbitrary positive weights and depths in [l0,l1], via the Gelfand-Fekete growth rate pRad (no Mathlib Perron-Frobenius). Scope: the flagship derives 1 < r(0) for the UNWEIGHTED transfer from the noncycle hypothesis P1 via lem:app-rho-one-cycle, which is NOT formalized (see that record); in Lean the supercriticality is a hypothesis. (vi) proved: deck-odd normal form, graded clock scaling, modular characterisation D0 = J e^{beta N} in a flat sheet gauge, and the bounded Krein-self-adjoint correction class (affine_modular, signed_dirac_krein_selfadjoint).

thm:projective-revision.title: Automatic projective revision algebra
thm:projective-revision.note: All four items proved in the lorentzian track. (i) automatic projective lift and scalar cocycle (thm:projective-lift / thm:spatial-multiplier-scalar-main); (ii) the +-1-valued alternating commutator form (lem:commutator-pm1, def:modular-form-main); (iii) adjunction of the temporal label via the Krein exchange row (thm:canonical-temporal-row); (iv) radical-centre dictionary, block decomposition, and the primitive Clifford matrix type C_sigma[H_prim] = M_{2^m}(C) = Cl_{2m}(C) via the Jordan-Wigner construction for every m (thm:radical-centre, thm:factor-quotients-corrected, thm:primitivity-canonical, thm:clifford-factor).

thm:external-core.title: Minimal external M4(C) core
thm:external-core.note: The minimality core is fully proved: even primitive rank, exclusion of 2+1, odd spatial rank, three as the first spatially nondegenerate rank (thm:minimal-nondegenerate-3plus1 chain), the hyperbolic temporal pair and its forced timelike square (gamma^0)^2 = -1 (cor:canonical-hyperbolic-core, prop:forced-timelike-generator), and the concrete (1,3) Clifford family with all gamma identities (CliffordConcrete / 31-endpoint records). Scope: two flagship-specific steps are not verbatim in Lean: (a) the marked-hyperplane decomposition of lem:app-temporal-partner (unique r in rad(omega|K), nondegeneracy of K0, H = span{t,r} perp K0) - see that record; (b) the explicit tensor factorization A_act = M4(C) (x) M_{2^{m-2}}(C) - the Jordan-Wigner isomorphism proves each factor's matrix type for every rank, but the commuting-factor Schur-uniqueness completion is the step already disclosed as unformalized in lem:temporal-clifford-completion. Both are finite F2/matrix algebra, no analysis.

thm:octahedral-record.title: Canonical external direction record
thm:octahedral-record.note: The load-bearing content is proved: the six-direction cross-polytope frame has exact state-independent second moment I3/3 (crossPolytope_second_moment), six is the minimal isotropic frame cardinality (lem:minimal-frame), the kappa = 3 normalization recovers the exact principal symbol (isotropic rounding and 31-endpoint records), and the symbol square (xi_0^2 - |xi|^2) 1 is KreinCliffordDatum.symbol_square. Scope: the Lueders-instrument packaging (K_{i,+-} = P_{i,+-}/sqrt(3), sum K*K = 1, trace preservation) is elementary projection algebra not encoded verbatim; the state-independence claim as stated for density matrices rides on the proved frame identity.

thm:flat-limit.title: Lorentzian symbol and flat Hamiltonian limit
thm:flat-limit.note: Proved at the symbol/band level, following the lorentzian track's disclosed convention. (i) symbol square and (1,3) signature: symbol_square + signature_lorentzian_iff. (ii) constant-frame equivalence: thm:frame-universality (unitary dilation conjugates the symbol to the standard massless Dirac multiplier). (iii)-(iv) the discrete central-difference symbols converge with explicit cubic band error (discrete_symbol_limit, resetSymbol_tendsto), generators have finite propagation, and the Hamiltonian multipliers are self-adjoint (alpha_star, multiplier_square). (vi) fixed-band norm-resolvent with rate O(h^2): band_symbol_bound + resolvent_identity. Scope: the L^2 strong-resolvent packaging of (iv), and all of (v) (propagator and C_0 functional-calculus convergence via lem:app-core-resolvent), are the unformalized operator-analytic layer - the same noted step recorded at thm:operator-limit / thm:full-operator in the lorentzian ledger.

cor:self-averaged-flat.title: Self-averaged flat endpoint
cor:self-averaged-flat.note: Maps to thm:self-averaging of the lorentzian track: pairwise-uncorrelated reset fluctuations concentrate the empirical second moment at 1/N rate, and Lipschitz symbol dependence plus band convergence transfer this to the operators. Scope (carried over): the Lean hypothesis (pairwise uncorrelated, finite sample space) differs from the flagship's stationary-ergodic sequence with Birkhoff's theorem; the almost-sure LLN/ergodic packaging is unformalized. Mathlib now contains Birkhoff-type ergodic theorems, so upgrading to the stated stationary-ergodic form is a plausible medium-effort extension.

thm:torsion-cancellation.title: Exchange-selected torsion cancellation
thm:torsion-cancellation.note: Proved: the common-source product kernel is exchange covariant, its stationary law is exchange invariant and unique on the positive recurrent support, and every exchange-odd observable (in particular the translational defect) has zero stationary mean (thm:exchange-closure / thm:stationary-exchange). The explicit product form pi(z,a,b) = pi_Z(z)R_z(a)R_z(b) is realized on the common-origin model (diamondKernel, diamond_zero_defect). The contrast claim that detailed balance alone does NOT cancel torsion is also proved (detailed_balance_not_torsion), matching the flagship's countermodel.

thm:curved-limit.title: Curved Levi--Civita strong-resolvent limit
thm:curved-limit.note: The finite/algebraic mechanism is proved: (i) second-moment covariance gives an orthogonal comparison landing in SO(3) with orientation via the determinant functional calculus (prop:second-moment-isometry, prop:metric-comparison); (ii) the stationary translational Cartan defect vanishes (thm:channel-torsion + thm:torsion-cancellation); (iii) the discrete Koszul formula and Cartan uniqueness reconstruct the Levi-Civita connection (thm:fundamental); the covariant central-difference cancellation and second-order consistency identities are proved, as are the quantitative resolvent bounds (resolvent_diff_bound) and the bounded renewal potential residue. (vi) dependence only through (M, Clifford datum, clock, potential) is thm:canonicity. Scope (carried over from the lorentzian ledger's thm:curved-limit): three operator-analytic steps remain open - the L^2 varying-coefficient covariant-consistency estimate, the Sobolev-domain graph limit, and the Trotter-Kato/strong-resolvent packaging of (iv)-(v).

cor:curvature-survives.title: Curvature is not suppressed
cor:curvature-survives.note: Proved: the plaquette splits into independent translational (torsion) and rotational (curvature) leading components (lem:plaquette-split), and the exchange argument constrains only the translational one; the rotational holonomy remains free.

thm:master.title: Flagship master theorem
thm:master.note: Assembly record in the convention of thm:structural-reconstruction / thm:lorentzian-phase / thm:realized-curved-sector (renewal ledger), all proved as bundles: items (I)-(II) are prop:common-object + thm:predictive-geometry; (III)-(IV) thm:signed-clock; (V) thm:projective-revision; (VI) thm:external-core; (VII) thm:octahedral-record + the symbol calculation; (VIII) thm:flat-limit + cor:self-averaged-flat; (IX) thm:torsion-cancellation + thm:curved-limit. Each component's proof status and analytic scope notes are recorded at its own entry; the master theorem inherits exactly those scopes (chiefly: the strong-resolvent/propagator packaging of VIII-IX, and the two finite-algebra gaps at thm:external-core).

cor:logical-strength.title: Exact logical strength
cor:logical-strength.note: The nesting (a)<(b)<(c) is the proved bundle structure (cor:genuine-phases in the renewal ledger), and the consistency of the excluded counterphases is witnessed by proved countermodels: single-cycle clock obstruction, deck-symmetric orientation cancellation, spatially degenerate rank one, detailed-balance-with-torsion chain, and the Ising phase pair for orientation/torsion coexistence.

thm:compact-journal.title: Compact journal statement
thm:compact-journal.note: Logically equivalent compressed restatement of thm:master; see that record for the component anchors and inherited analytic scope notes. No independent mathematical content.

prop:no-overstatement.title: No-overstatement boundary
prop:no-overstatement.note: Mixed status by item. PROVED countermodels: (1) cycle/classical phases (finite_cycle_beta_obstruction); (3) growth exponent independent of Clifford rank (lattice-shell growth records); (4) polyhedral order cone vs round Lorentz cone (polyhedral_obstruction, extreme-ray comparison); (5) no finite symmetric orientation selection (no_finite_spontaneous_orientation); (6) detailed balance does not remove torsion (detailed_balance_not_torsion, exactly the flagship's 2x2 chain). Item (8)'s isotropy/profile freedom is partially covered by isotropy_not_derived. NOT encoded: (2) the tensor-with-internal-factor countermodel (easy given Jordan-Wigner for all m), (7) the aliasing-box counterexample defeating global norm-resolvent convergence (a finite Fourier-multiplier computation, feasible), and the prose-level free-datum items (9)-(11).

lem:app-core-resolvent.title: Common-core strong-resolvent criterion
lem:app-core-resolvent.note: Not formalized, and deliberately so far: this is the single lemma standing behind every strong-resolvent / propagator / C_0-functional-calculus clause of thm:flat-limit(iv)-(v) and thm:curved-limit(iv)-(v). It needs unbounded self-adjoint operator theory on a fixed Hilbert space (graph cores, resolvent bounds |Im z|^{-1}, spectral-theorem consequences). Mathlib's unbounded-operator and spectral-theory support has been growing but the library currently proves resolvent estimates only at the matrix/Fourier-multiplier level (resolvent_identity, resolvent_diff_bound, band_symbol_bound). Formalizing this lemma is THE main analytic work item for the flagship chain; everything downstream of it in the manuscript is already proved at symbol/band level.

lem:app-future-minimality.title: Future congruence and universal minimality
lem:app-future-minimality.note: Proved in full in the renewal track (prop:largest-congruence + thm:minimal-predictive-memory): future equivalence is a postcomposition-stable congruence and its quotient is the unique reduced future-sufficient memory up to unique isomorphism.

lem:app-successor.title: Resolved successor congruence
lem:app-successor.note: Proved (lem:conditional-successor): conditional future profiles are preserved by successful resolved extensions, giving the well-defined partial successor map on the conditional quotient.

lem:app-reference-renewal.title: Reference-renewal identity
lem:app-reference-renewal.note: Proved (thm:predictive-reference-renewal + cor:predictive-reference-path-law): in a reduced future-tomographic realization every resolved edge maps the reference state to w_e times the successor reference state, and path weights multiply.

lem:app-ucp-unit.title: A UCP unit is an automorphism
lem:app-ucp-unit.note: Proved (thm:predictive-unit / cor:units-automorphisms) by exactly the manuscript's Kadison-Schwarz multiplicative-domain argument.

lem:app-positive-triple.title: Bounded shifts, commutators, and compact resolvent
lem:app-positive-triple.note: Proved (thm:fibre-dichotomy + thm:triple): the finite-fibre Cauchy-Schwarz shift bound, the bounded-commutator estimate, finite shells (compact resolvent), and the zeta-abscissa identification with the predictive growth exponent (ZetaAbscissa records).

lem:app-minimal-cover.title: Cone-positive minimal enrichment
lem:app-minimal-cover.note: Proved (thm:classification + thm:cover chains): cone-positive unitaries permute extremal rays, rank two is forced and realized, gauge classes biject with H^1(G;Z/2), and the nontrivial class gives the connected principal double cover with sheet-sign fundamental symmetry.

lem:app-rho-one-cycle.title: Irreducible integer matrix at spectral radius one
lem:app-rho-one-cycle.note: Not formalized. The Lean pressure theorem (pressure_selects_beta) takes supercriticality 1 < r(0) as a hypothesis; this lemma is what discharges it from the P1 noncycle condition (strongly connected noncycle graph => spectral radius of the adjacency matrix exceeds one). Since the library implements the spectral radius as the Gelfand-Fekete entry-sum growth rate pRad (no Mathlib Perron-Frobenius), the natural formalization is combinatorial: a strongly connected noncycle multigraph has a vertex with two outgoing edges, hence exponentially many closed walks, so pRad > 1. Small self-contained project; it is the only missing piece of thm:signed-clock.

lem:app-temporal-partner.title: Canonical temporal partner
lem:app-temporal-partner.note: Not formalized verbatim. Adjacent proved pieces exist: exists_pairing_one, rank2Form_nondegenerate / rank2Form_hyperbolic_pair (the span{t,r} hyperbolic plane), even_finrank_of_isAlt_nondegenerate, and the stdSymplectic models. Missing is the flagship-specific F2 linear algebra: for a marked hyperplane K in a nondegenerate (H, omega), the radical of omega|K is one-dimensional with unique generator r, omega(t,r) = 1, K0 = K \cap t^perp is nondegenerate of dimension 2m-2, and H = span{t,r} perp K0. Elementary finite symplectic algebra over F2 with no analysis; together with the commuting-factor completion at thm:external-core this is the second (and last) finite-algebra work item.
